subject: MSBA Eligibility Phase Deliverable Submissions
overview: The committee reviewed the completion of all state-required submissions for the eligibility phase of the high school building project. Members discussed the upcoming transition to procuring an owner's project manager and architect.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 12, 2024, full committee meeting.

items.title: Eligibility Phase Status Report
items.summary: Reported the submission of all state-required deliverables to the MSBA, including the feasibility study funding, educational profile, enrollment projections, and maintenance planning documentation. A meeting with state officials to certify enrollment numbers is scheduled for late July.

items.title: Module 2 Preparation
items.summary: Discussed the requirements for 'Module 2,' which involves forming a selection committee to procure an Owner’s Project Manager (OPM) and eventually an architect.

items.title: Schedule and Subcommittee Updates
items.summary: Canceled the August full committee meeting and redirected that time to the Communications and Community Engagement Subcommittee to focus on public surveys and FAQs.
